records.subject: Nutrien / phosphate manufactured product
records.expected_read: Higher comparable selling prices did not offset the measured cost increase; do not turn phosphate price strength into company profitability.
records.scope_warning: Issuer manufactured-product basis, not all world phosphate producers.
records.next_evidence: Subsequent same-basis realization, consumed input cost and operating volume.

records.subject: Mosaic / sulfur-to-phosphate cost timing
records.reference_period: Q2 actual costs; Q3 contracts; management Q4 accounting expectation
records.expected_read: A later purchase-contract cost is not current-period COGS; preserve the expected accounting lag and actual-versus-forecast split.
records.scope_warning: DAP realization is narrower than the whole phosphate segment margin.
records.next_evidence: Original inventory/consumption and later earnings evidence; a new spot quote alone is insufficient.

records.subject: CF / ownership-sensitive cash and capacity denominator
records.reference_period: TTM cash reconciliation and H1 2026 capital
records.expected_read: Reported FCF includes cash exchanges with noncontrolling holders; an ownership allocation of construction is not the same as actual funding cash.
records.scope_warning: No mixing of TTM cash and H1 capex; utilization excludes unavailable capacity.
records.next_evidence: Actual partner contributions, spending and plant availability on matched periods.

records.subject: Yara / seasonal working capital
records.expected_read: Keep seasonal operating cash separate from asset receipts; a future inventory release is a hypothesis until observed.
records.scope_warning: Analytical cash subtractions are not a universal normalized FCF definition.
records.next_evidence: Sell-through, collection and inventory movements during the relevant sales/application season.
unresolved: One-million displayed investing reconciliation gap retained

records.subject: FMC / licensing and operating outlook
records.reference_period: Q2 actual and FY2026 guidance vintage
records.expected_read: An identified upfront receipt can improve liquidity while the operating outlook weakens; do not claim a recurring recovery.
records.scope_warning: Subtracting one receipt is not a modeled company without the licensing agreement.
records.next_evidence: Remaining contract economics, recurring orders and cash collections after the event.
unresolved: Complete contractual future rights are not modeled

records.subject: K+S / guidance and financial investments
records.reference_period: H1 2026 cash; annual guidance; July16 cited consensus
records.expected_read: A guidance increase is distinct from an expectation surprise; cash purchases of financial investments differ from operating loss.
records.scope_warning: Consensus is attributed to the issuer-cited vintage, not independently verified latest consensus.
records.next_evidence: Matched expectation revisions and resolution of capital-perimeter difference.
unresolved: EUR19.6m capital-perimeter difference, not silently assigned
